title: The Lonely man in the lighthouse
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：lonely　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lonely 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the herder wrote of ① a lonely man in the lighthouse in the ledger, and everybody in the pasture said at once that it was ② more lonely than the one named there the year before. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the herder, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the lonely ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most lonely man in the lighthouse anybody in the pasture had ever seen, or so the ledger for December 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lonely to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the lonely ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lonely road over the moor, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lonely as the road over the moor they had once had in the old pasture. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lonely or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lonely, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next pasture called the whole plan ⑧ quite lonely; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the lonely ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, before dawn, she wrote of another lonely man in the lighthouse in the same ledger, and the work, which took two winters, seemed ⑨ more lonely than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most lonely road over the moor in the whole pasture, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the lonely ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 孤独（前置定语 a lonely man in the lighthouse：1979 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的那件孤独的人）
B. adj. 孤独／偏僻（比较级 more lonely than：文中两处，一处比灯塔里孤独的人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 孤独／偏僻（最高级 the most lonely：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 孤独（表语 too lonely to do：母亲觉得它太孤独，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 偏僻（前置定语 a lonely road over the moor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩偏僻的路）
F. adj. 偏僻（同级比较 as lonely as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩荒原上偏僻的路相比）
G. adj. 偏僻（后置定语 something lonely：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 偏僻（受程度副词修饰 quite lonely：那位邻人的评价）

items.q: a lonely man in the lighthouse
the most lonely man in the lighthouse anybody
a lonely road over the moor
The most lonely road over the moor in

answers.why: lonely 意为“孤独”，1979 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的是“一件孤独的人”，此处作前置定语 a lonely man in the lighthouse。
lonely 意为“孤独”，此处用比较级 more lonely than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
lonely 意为“孤独”，牧群台账上 十二月 那行字说它是牧场里最孤独的一件，故用最高级 the most lonely man in the lighthouse。
lonely 意为“孤独”，母亲认为这件东西“太孤独了，谁也用不上”，too lonely to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩偏僻的路”，此处作前置定语 a lonely road over the moor。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩荒原上偏僻的路一样偏僻”，同级比较用 as lonely as。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，牧群台账上那半行字要的是“偏僻的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lonely。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，邻牧场来的那位邻人认为这套计划“相当偏僻”，quite 修饰原级 lonely。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，1989 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要偏僻”，故用比较级 more lonely than。
lonely 意为“偏僻”，母亲 1991 年说的是“整个牧场里最偏僻的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most lonely road over the moor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，牧人在牧群台账里记下了一件孤独的人。（a lonely man in the lighthouse）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更孤独。（more lonely than …）
母亲觉得它太孤独，谁也用不上。（too lonely to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩偏僻的路。（a lonely road over the moor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩荒原上偏僻的路一样偏僻。（as lonely as …）
到了 1986 年，牧群台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件偏僻的东西。（something lonely）
answers: In 1979 the herder wrote of a lonely man in the lighthouse in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more lonely than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too lonely to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lonely road over the moor.
He said nobody would call it as lonely as the road over the moor they had once had.
By 1986 the ledger asked for nothing but something lonely.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lonely 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the herder wrote of a lonely man in the lighthouse in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most lonely man in the lighthouse in the pasture, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too lonely to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lonely road over the moor, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next pasture called the plan quite lonely, and everybody laughed.
The lonely ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
